notes: The target PMID 36942789 reports day-28 mortality, rather than the requested 30-day or in-hospital window. It states that 800 patients underwent randomization and data from 795 patients were analyzed; the mortality denominators are analyzed counts, and intention-to-treat is not explicitly stated. Arm-specific randomized totals are NOT_IN_PACKET. The other held document, PMID 32876689, reports a COVID-19 population under the same registry identifier: 11 hydrocortisone deaths and 20 placebo deaths, with randomized totals of 76 and 73, respectively, and a day-21 treatment-failure outcome. Those observations are not used for this target PMID; its treatment-failure percentages are not mortality percentages.
